sourcePrd: Taskbox bulk select / bulk approve-reject actions

testcases.TestCaseName: Bulk-select CTA visible on Leave Requests when at least 2 pending tasks exist
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Bulk-select CTA is visible on app bar when >=2 pending tasks exist on applicable page.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager logged in on Android 13; 2. Taskbox has >=2 pending Leave Requests
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap bottom nav Home then navigate to Taskbox via ValueKey 'home_taskbox_entry' 2. [Both] Tap Leave Requests category via ValueKey 'taskbox_category_leave_requests' 3. [Both] Wait until task list renders (max 30s) 4. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_app_bar_cta' is visible on app bar ? Expected: bulk-select icon displayed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Bulk-select CTA is visible on app bar when >=2 pending tasks exist on applicable page.

testcases.TestCaseName: Bulk-select CTA hidden when only 1 pending task exists
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Bulk-select app bar CTA is not rendered when fewer than 2 pending tasks.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager logged in; 2. Leave Requests page has exactly 1 pending task
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Navigate to Taskbox > Leave Requests 2. [Both] Assert ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_app_bar_cta' is NOT visible ? Expected: CTA hidden when pending count < 2
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Bulk-select app bar CTA is not rendered when fewer than 2 pending tasks.

testcases.TestCaseName: App bar CTA enters bulk-select mode with checkboxes on all cards
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Page transitions to bulk-select mode; checkboxes appear on all visible task cards.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager logged in; 2. Leave Requests has >=3 pending tasks
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Navigate to Taskbox > Leave Requests 2. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_app_bar_cta' 3. [Both] Wait until ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_mode_container' is visible (max 15s) 4. [Both] Verify each visible card has ValueKey pattern 'taskbox_bulk_card_checkbox_{taskId}' ? Expected: bulk-select mode active with per-card checkboxes
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Page transitions to bulk-select mode; checkboxes appear on all visible task cards.

testcases.TestCaseName: Long-press on task card enters bulk-select mode with card pre-selected
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Long-press enters bulk-select mode; pressed card is pre-selected; count shows 1 selected; Approve/Reject enabled.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager logged in; 2. Leave Requests has >=2 pending tasks
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Navigate to Taskbox > Leave Requests 2. [Both] Long-press first task card ValueKey 'taskbox_task_card_{taskId}' 3. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_mode_container' visible ? Expected: bulk mode entered 4. [Both] Verify long-pressed card checkbox is checked and ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_selected_count_label' shows '1 selected'
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Long-press enters bulk-select mode; pressed card is pre-selected; count shows 1 selected; Approve/Reject enabled.
testcases.AutomationTargets: taskbox_task_card_{taskId}; taskbox_bulk_select_mode_container; taskbox_bulk_card_checkbox_{taskId}; taskbox_bulk_selected_count_label; taskbox_bulk_approve_cta; taskbox_bulk_reject_cta

testcases.TestCaseName: Tapping card in bulk-select mode toggles checkbox instead of opening detail
testcases.TestCaseDescription: In bulk-select mode, card tap toggles selection; request detail page does not open.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager in bulk-select mode on Leave Requests with >=2 tasks
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Enter bulk-select via app bar CTA 2. [Both] Tap body of unselected card ValueKey 'taskbox_task_card_{taskId}' 3. [Both] Verify checkbox becomes checked and count increments ? Expected: detail page NOT opened 4. [Both] Tap same card again ? Expected: checkbox unchecked
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: In bulk-select mode, card tap toggles selection; request detail page does not open.

testcases.TestCaseName: Normal mode card tap opens request detail page
testcases.TestCaseDescription: In normal mode, tapping a card opens the request detail page (no regression).
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager on Leave Requests in normal (non-bulk) mode
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Ensure bulk-select mode is NOT active 2. [Both] Tap task card ValueKey 'taskbox_task_card_{taskId}' 3. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_request_detail_screen' visible (max 20s) ? Expected: detail page opens
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: In normal mode, tapping a card opens the request detail page (no regression).

testcases.TestCaseName: Select All checks all currently loaded visible cards
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Select All selects all currently visible/loaded cards; count updates correctly.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager in bulk-select mode; 2. >=3 tasks loaded on screen
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_all_checkbox' 2. [Both] Verify all visible card checkboxes are checked ? Expected: all loaded cards selected 3. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_selected_count_label' matches visible card count
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Select All selects all currently visible/loaded cards; count updates correctly.

testcases.TestCaseName: Select All tapped again deselects all visible cards
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Second tap on Select All deselects all; count returns to 0; docked CTAs disabled.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager in bulk-select mode with all visible cards selected
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_all_checkbox' to deselect all 2. [Both] Verify all card checkboxes unchecked ? Expected: '0 selected' shown 3. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_approve_cta' and 'taskbox_bulk_reject_cta' are disabled/greyed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Second tap on Select All deselects all; count returns to 0; docked CTAs disabled.

testcases.TestCaseName: Approve and Reject CTAs enabled when at least one card selected
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Docked Approve and Reject CTAs become enabled when selected count >= 1.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager in bulk-select mode; 2. At least 1 card selected
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Select one card via checkbox 2. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_approve_cta' is enabled ? Expected: active state 3. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_reject_cta' is enabled ? Expected: active state
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Docked Approve and Reject CTAs become enabled when selected count >= 1.

testcases.TestCaseName: Bulk approve with optional comment completes successfully
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Bulk approve succeeds; optional comment accepted; toast displays '✓ {n} requests approved'; cards removed.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Tenant comment setting for Leave = Optional; 2. Manager selects 3 leave requests in bulk mode
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_approve_cta' 2. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_comment_modal' visible 3. [Both] Enter text in ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_comment_input' (optional) 4. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_comment_approve_cta' 5. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_success_toast' with text matching '2 requests approved' ? Expected: success toast shown 6. [Both] Verify approved cards removed from pending list
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Bulk approve succeeds; optional comment accepted; toast displays '✓ {n} requests approved'; cards removed.
testcases.AutomationTargets: taskbox_bulk_approve_cta; taskbox_bulk_comment_modal; taskbox_bulk_comment_input; taskbox_bulk_comment_approve_cta; taskbox_bulk_success_toast; taskbox_request_list

testcases.TestCaseName: Bulk reject with optional comment completes successfully
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Bulk reject succeeds with optional comment skipped; success toast shows correct count.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Tenant comment setting for Leave = Optional; 2. Manager selects 2 leave requests
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_reject_cta' 2. [Both] Wait for comment modal 3. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_comment_reject_cta' without entering comment 4. [Both] Verify toast ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_success_toast' shows '2 requests rejected'
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Bulk reject succeeds with optional comment skipped; success toast shows correct count.

testcases.TestCaseName: Comment modal Cancel returns to bulk-select without processing
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Cancel on comment modal returns to bulk-select; selections unchanged; no requests processed.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager selected 2 tasks; comment setting Optional
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap Approve CTA 2. [Both] Enter text in comment field 3. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_comment_cancel_cta' 4. [Both] Verify bulk-select mode still active and selections preserved ? Expected: no API call; cards still selected
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Cancel on comment modal returns to bulk-select; selections unchanged; no requests processed.

testcases.TestCaseName: Back icon exits bulk-select mode to normal list view
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Back icon exits bulk-select mode; normal task list behavior restored.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager in bulk-select mode with selections
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_exit_back_cta' on app bar 2. [Both] Verify ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_select_mode_container' is NOT visible ? Expected: normal list mode 3. [Both] Verify card tap opens detail (normal behavior restored)
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Back icon exits bulk-select mode; normal task list behavior restored.

testcases.TestCaseName: Network failure during bulk approve shows error toast and no requests processed
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Error toast shown with exact copy; no requests processed; user can retry.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager selects 3 tasks in bulk mode; 2. Simulate offline before submit
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap Approve and confirm in comment modal 2. [Both] Simulate network loss via Appium network API 3. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_error_toast' visible ? Expected: exact copy 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' 4. [Both] Verify all 3 tasks remain pending in list
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Error toast shown with exact copy; no requests processed; user can retry.

testcases.TestCaseName: Server-side error during bulk action shows backend error toast
testcases.TestCaseDescription: Server error toast displayed; no partial processing.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Manager selects tasks; 2. Backend returns server error for bulk approve
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Submit bulk approve 2. [Both] Wait for ValueKey 'taskbox_bulk_error_toast' visible ? Expected: backend error message displayed 3. [Both] Verify no requests processed
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Server error toast displayed; no partial processing.

testcases.TestCaseName: Optional comment does not block Approve CTA when comment empty

testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Approve CTA remains enabled with empty optional comment.

testcases.TestCaseName: Mandatory reject reason shows inline error when Confirm tapped with empty comment
testcases.TestCaseDescription: When reject reason is mandatory (reject_reason_mandatory_leaves), bulk reject modal Confirm stays tappable; tapping Confirm with empty comment shows inline error 'Comment is mandatory' and keeps modal open until comment entered.
testcases.Precondition: 1. Tenant reject-reason setting for Leave = Mandatory (reject_reason_mandatory_leaves); 2. 2 tasks selected
testcases.Steps: 1. [Both] Tap Reject CTA 2. [Both] With empty comment, tap Confirm on reject modal 3. [Both] Verify inline error 'Comment is mandatory' visible and modal still open 4. [Both] Enter comment, verify error clears and Confirm is usable
testcases.ExpectedOutcome: Inline error 'Comment is mandatory' shown on empty Confirm; error clears after comment entered and Confirm remains enabled.
